covered.label: National Rail
covered.detail: Every train calling at Manchester Piccadilly, Manchester Victoria and this region's other stations, from the UK's national real-time feed.

partial.label: Manchester Metrolink tram
partial.detail: Only the line ends and a few major stops are listed so far (15 of about 99 tram stops), and the tram operator has no confirmed public live-times feed yet — those stops aren't offered in the station picker or Near me for now, rather than being selectable and then showing an error. They stay on file for when a confirmed feed exists.

stations: 101 stations and stops: 87 National Rail stations across Greater Manchester (36 reassigned in from rest-of-england 15 Sep 2026, docs/jim-brief-rest-of-england-reassignment.md) plus 14 Metrolink stops.
